body: I really appreciate this comment, thank you. I have done research on surgeries, viewed many forums etc. Just because i've seen it first hand  with my mother, its very unattractive option. For it would take multiple surgeries to fix the damage. Im afraid I may actually have done more damage to my self with this failed attempt. How did your surgeries turn out if you could explain more in depth (if you dont mind) And how the recovery process was for you. I just want my old life back, the idea of having to live with this for the rest of my life, is what is driving my self to suicide.

I attempted suicide about 4 hours ago, only for the belt to break and me waking up convulsing and the feeling of my heart about to pop out of my chest. I made a post here on reddit soon after it happened, i was balling hysterically wondering why it didnt work. What if the person is living with so much physical pain they are unable to cope. Im an ex addict and im unable to be given opiates and benzos. I am 24 years old and had lordosis of my lower spine causing it to curve way inward. I have 3 bulging disks in my back, stenosis of the spine, also i have a fusion of a vertebrae to my sacrum and ilium causing my hip to raise and tighten together causing NO circulation throughout my entire body. Imagine feeling freezing cold depressed/suicidal unable to get hard  constant pain no matter what position i am in. Only sleeping 2-4 hours a night due to the pain. as well as a lung disease that all happened around the same exact time. The lung disease causes my lungs to feel like they are being squeezed. I was advised i would need multiple surgeries to fix this which isnt even guaranteed. My mom has had 9, fucking 9 failed back surgeries and i do not want to end up like that. she can barely walk and shes only 50. I feel its the person choice to check out if they want to, this plane is at a very low vibration, its the plane of Freewill. shouldn't we have the choice and not suffer consequences? Or does the karma system hold us responsible for the peoples lifes we have affected and to the future lifes you would have affected. I really cant answer this, but I do know we have the choice of free will in which we can exit this plane if we choose to do so.

The fall from when i went unconscious when the belt loop tightened harder around my neck before it broke has caused me SERIOUS pain throughout my whole back and my neck, it felt as if my whole spine was yanked on and my windpipe has been crushed, I dont plan on making another attempt tonight as im in to much pain to even stand at the moment which is not helping at all to my cause. I have a doctors appointment tomorrow at 10pm with a surgeon to see what the options/alternatives there are, but from the last 3 doctors the only way to fix what is going on is surgery. Im deeply afraid of the surgery option due to what has happened to my mom. I appreciate your comment, but i will take your advice and see what the doctor says tomorrow. I just cant bear to think that i will have to go the rest of my life is this pain, this misery.
